recentItems.title: Why China remains a magnet for global investment
recentItems.description: "Capital flows to where it sees opportunity." Global investors attending the 26th China International Fair for Investment and Trade (#CIFIT) in Xiamen, east China, shared their views on why China remains a market they cannot afford to miss. #GLOBALink

recentItems.title: China leads in innovation clusters for fourth straight year
recentItems.description:
Where are the world's biggest innovation hubs?
A new ranking from the World Intellectual Property Organization #WIPO shows that China has 25 of the world's top 100 innovation clusters -- the most of any country for the fourth consecutive year.
WIPO says these clusters bring together universities, researchers, inventors, venture capital and R&D -- creating the conditions in which breakthrough ideas can flourish.

recentItems.title: Ndongkeh Nelson Maineh: China gives me chance to take what I learn back home
recentItems.description: Cameroonian student Ndongkeh Nelson Maineh is studying soil science at Jilin Agricultural University. Through lab and field research, he explores ways to improve soil health and crop yields, hoping to bring what he learns home and support more sustainable farming.

recentItems.title: 2026 CIFTIS Opens: Global Exhibitors Praise China's Services
recentItems.description:
The 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services (CIFTIS) has kicked off at Beijing's Shougang Park!
From green energy and digital technology to overseas-expansion services, this year's fair has brought together exhibitors from over 90 countries, regions and international organizations, with Norway featured as the Guest Country of Honor. CIFTIS has been a vital bridge for global cooperation in trade in services!

recentItems.title: Chinese firms driving global consumer electronics innovation, says IFA CEO
recentItems.description: Global consumer electronics innovation is now being increasingly driven by China, said Leif Lindner, CEO of IFA Management GmbH, adding that the clearest advantage of Chinese companies is speed. #GLOBALink
